changed.from: For a finite positive regular-maximal \(\mathcal G\) and supplied \(A,Y\), the graphical recursion has the following implementation-independent dichotomy: it derives a trace functional, or its first failed target-relevant district pair satisfies the invariant \(\Delta=(\kappa_*,D,D')\) of \(\text{thm:qe-failure-compiler}\) and therefore compiles to a colored hedge and a same-observed, different-query positive model pair. For every compatible \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), its unique partition cell carries an identifying value for every \(y\) if and only if \(Q_a^{\mathcal M}\) is constant over \(\mathfrak F(\mathcal G,P_{\mathrm{obs}})\); otherwise it carries \(\mathsf W_j\). changed.to:
For a finite positive regular-maximal \(\mathcal G\) and supplied \(A,Y\), the history-preserving symbolic procedure \(\operatorname{TCF}\) constructs a finite semialgebraic partition
\[
\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}
\quad\text{of}\quad
\{\mathbf p:\exists\theta\,\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\}.
\]
For every compatible \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), every \(a\in\mathcal X_A\), and every \(y\in\mathcal X_Y\), its unique cell carries \(f_{a,j}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)\) if and only if \(\mathcal M\mapsto Q_a^{\mathcal M}(y)\) is constant on \(\mathfrak F(\mathcal G,P_{\mathrm{obs}})\); in that case
\[
f_{a,j}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)=Q_a^{\mathcal M}(y)
\quad\text{for every }\mathcal M\in\mathfrak F(\mathcal G,P_{\mathrm{obs}}).
\]
If the coordinate is not constant, the cell carries \(\mathsf W_j\). Under \(\operatorname{Exact}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\), a sample from \(\mathsf W_j\) decodes to strictly positive, individual-edge-factorized models \(\mathcal M_0,\mathcal M_1\) satisfying \(P_{\mathcal M_0}(\mathcal O)=P_{\mathcal M_1}(\mathcal O)=P_{\mathrm{obs}}\) and \(Q_a^{\mathcal M_0}(y)\neq Q_a^{\mathcal M_1}(y)\), and the partial diagnostic \(\operatorname{Compile}_{\mathrm{col}}\) terminates with either a checked record or an exhaustion tag. If every coordinate is constant for both \(a_0\) and \(a_1\), then the observed-law functional identifies the causal contrast:
\[
\tau_{s_Y}
=\sum_{y\in\mathcal X_Y}s_Y(y)
\{f_{a_1,j}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)-f_{a_0,j}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)\}.
\]
This is pointwise semialgebraic completeness over the observed-law fiber; it makes no graphwise colored-hedge completeness claim.
changed.reason: The real-closed-field constancy test is complete at a fixed observed law, but it does not establish an implementation-independent graphwise failure invariant or colored-hedge realization. The proposed statement retains the proved coordinatewise fiber dichotomy, exact positive model-pair witness, and estimand map.

changed.from: Given an exact specialized witness \(\omega=(a,y,\theta^0,\theta^1)\) and its finite failed colored-recursion trace \(\mathcal T\), scan recursion states in prefix order and form the first-divergence record \(\Delta(\omega,\mathcal T)=(\kappa_*,D,D')\): every proper predecessor has equal trace polynomials under the two response vectors, \(D\subsetneq D'\) are the first target-relevant reachable districts with common roots ancestral to \(Y\), \(D\cap A=\varnothing\), \(D'\cap A\neq\varnothing\), and the query difference persists after eliminating vertices outside \(D'\). Delete common ancestors outside \(D'\), retain the minimal equally rooted forests in \(D,D'\), and color their edges by the prefix-closed licenses stored in \(\kappa_*\). Decode \(\theta^0,\theta^1\) through the selected tables and independent factor weights. The output is a candidate \((H,\mathcal M_0,\mathcal M_1)\); the invariant and every certificate property are conclusions of \(\text{thm:qe-failure-compiler}\).
changed.to: Given an exact specialized negative-cell witness \(\omega=(a,y,\theta^0,\theta^1)\) and a finite retained operation history \(\mathcal T\), first decode \(\theta^0,\theta^1\) through their selected response tables and product laws over the individual edge and private factors, obtaining \(\mathcal M_0,\mathcal M_1\). Next enumerate, in a fixed prefix and vertex-subset order, every triple \((\kappa_*,D,D')\) occurring in \(\mathcal T\) and test the conjuncts of the candidate predicate \(\Delta(\omega,\mathcal T)=(\kappa_*,D,D')\). Trace equalities are tested after clearing the supported nonzero denominators, using the Thom encodings supplied by exact specialization. Return \((\operatorname{found}(\kappa_*,D,D'),\mathcal M_0,\mathcal M_1)\) for the first successful test and return \((\operatorname{exhausted},\mathcal M_0,\mathcal M_1)\) if the finite enumeration ends. This is a partial graphical diagnostic: neither tag asserts existence of a colored hedge, membership in \(\operatorname{CH}(\mathcal G,A,Y)\), realization of a forest by the decoded models, or alignment of the algebraic sample with a graphwise recursion failure.
changed.reason: The construction must not smuggle in existence of the first-divergence invariant or forest properties. The corrected construction decodes the algebraic witness and performs a finite optional record test with an honest exhaustion branch.

Choose the unique cell containing \(p_o=P_{\mathrm{obs}}(o)\); isolate the unique \(z\) on an identifying cell or extract algebraic \(\theta^0,\theta^1\) on a negative cell. No operation on an arbitrary unencoded population real is defined.
changed.reason: For transcendental exact-real observed cells, witness coordinates are algebraic over the ordered field generated by the observed coordinates, not necessarily real algebraic over the rationals.

changed.from: On formal input \((\mathcal G,A,Y,\mathbf p)\), start from every observed-trace kernel written as a rational expression in \(\mathbf p\) and recursively apply ancestral marginalization, district decomposition, licensed \(\Phi_v^{\lambda}\) updates, and delayed \(\Sigma_c\) updates. Canonicalize states modulo admissible adjacent swaps and memoize \((\mathcal H,F,c,\Lambda)\). At each terminal state append the symbolic formulas \(\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\), \(\mathsf I_{a,y}(\mathcal G;\mathbf p)\), and \(\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z)\). One common signed-subresultant CAD refines these outputs into \(\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}\), with a rational trace expression or unique-value graph on identifying cells and \(\mathsf W_j\) on negative cells. The notation \(\operatorname{TCF}(\mathcal G,A,Y,P_{\mathrm{obs}})\) means this symbolic object with the formal names \(p_o=P_{\mathrm{obs}}(o)\); selecting a numerical cell is only the separate exact specialization. The procedure neither names nor returns a colored hedge.
changed.to: On formal input \((\mathcal G,A,Y,\mathbf p)\), start from every observed margin and partial-context trace kernel written as a rational expression in \(\mathbf p\). Recursively branch only by strict ancestral marginalization, restriction to a proper child of a nontrivial district decomposition, a licensed \(\Phi_v^{\lambda}\) update, or a delayed \(\Sigma_{c'}\) update that strictly extends the partial context. Retain the complete operation word and memoize only literal complete tuples \(\kappa=(\mathcal H,F,c,q,\pi,\Lambda)\), including the syntax of \(q\), \(\pi\), and every provenance entry in \(\Lambda\). An adjacent-swap optimization may merge two branches only after replaying both license orders from their common pre-swap state in a fixed canonical order and verifying literal equality of the two resulting complete tuples; fixing and selection are never commuted. For every terminal tuple and every \((a,y)\), append one package containing \(\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\), \(\mathsf I_{a,y}(\mathcal G;\mathbf p)\), \(\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z)\), and any candidate rational trace expression. Reuse the same scoped response-variable names across packages, concatenate all partition-generating formulas, and run one common signed-subresultant CAD. Store a rational trace expression only on cells where its equality to \(\mathsf V_{a,y}\) has been verified; otherwise store the unique-value graph, and store \(\mathsf W_j\) on negative cells. The notation \(\operatorname{TCF}(\mathcal G,A,Y,P_{\mathrm{obs}})\) denotes this symbolic object with formal names \(p_o=P_{\mathrm{obs}}(o)\); numerical cell selection is the separate exact specialization. The procedure neither names nor returns a colored hedge.
changed.reason: Memoizing only graphical fields and a trace list is not history safe. The corrected procedure retains and replays literal complete tuples, preserves fixing-selection order, requires strict recursive progress, and feeds all terminal packages to one common CAD.

changed.from: For \((n,\ell,c,t,h,g,K_{\mathcal G},p,s)\), define \[B_{\mathrm{state}}(n,\ell,c,t)=6^n c\sum_{j=0}^{t}(\ell+1)^j,\qquad B_{\mathrm{tot}}=B_{\mathrm{state}}(n,\ell,c,t)\{1+|\mathcal X_A||\mathcal X_Y|\operatorname{CAD}(p,s)\}.\] The factor \(3^n\) bounds current vertex statuses, \(2^n\) bounds fixed sets, \(c\) bounds partial contexts, and the geometric sum bounds ordered license traces. Each doubled terminal formula has \(2(g+hK_{\mathcal G})\) quantified response variables, \(|\mathcal X_{\mathcal O}|\) free observed-cell variables, and total symbolic encoding length at most \(s\). The fixed CAD eliminates only the response variables, retains the observed-cell parameters, and outputs no more than \(\operatorname{CAD}(p,s)\) cells and elementary steps. This is a symbolic bound; exact point specialization is a separate finite sign computation under \(\operatorname{Exact}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\).
changed.to:
For the size quantities \((n,\ell,c,h,g,K_{\mathcal G},p,s)\), define
\[
L_{\mathrm{op}}=2^{n+1}+n(\ell+1)+c+1,
\qquad
B_{\mathrm{state}}=2^n c\sum_{j=0}^{2n}L_{\mathrm{op}}^j,
\]
\[
N_{\mathrm{term}}=|\mathcal X_A||\mathcal X_Y|B_{\mathrm{state}},
\qquad
S_{\mathrm{tot}}=N_{\mathrm{term}}(s+1),
\qquad
B_{\mathrm{tot}}=B_{\mathrm{state}}+\operatorname{CAD}(p,S_{\mathrm{tot}}).
\]
Here \(2^n c\) bounds the initial observed-margin and partial-context traces; the operation alphabet respectively bounds ancestral and district subset choices, vertex-license choices, strict context extensions, and one harmless terminal marker. The recursive word length \(2n\) counts every provenance-bearing marginalization, district restriction, fixing, and selection in its actual order. The quantity \(s\) bounds the binary encoding length of the partition-generating part of one terminal \((a,y)\)-package, including polynomial counts, degrees, integer coefficients, variable indices, Boolean connectives, and free observed-cell names. One common CAD receives the concatenated input of length at most \(S_{\mathrm{tot}}\), eliminates only the response variables, retains \(\mathbf p\), and is bounded by \(\operatorname{CAD}(p,S_{\mathrm{tot}})\). Exact point specialization is a separate finite sign computation under \(\operatorname{Exact}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\).
changed.reason: The old state budget did not count complete operation words or the encoding length of the concatenated common-CAD input. The corrected construction uses a decreasing progress measure, a full operation alphabet, and the total length parameter.

{"id":"def:tcf-procedure","name":"Trace-aware colored fixing procedure","construction":"On formal input \((\mathcal G,A,Y,\mathbf p)\), first construct the response-polynomial feasibility formula \(\exists\theta\,\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\), all coordinate-constancy formulas \(\mathsf I_{a,y}(\mathcal G;\mathbf p)\), and the direct target-constancy formula \(\mathsf I_{\tau}(\mathcal G;\mathbf p,\mathbf s)\) with \(\mathbf s\) retained as a formal real vector. Run one signed-subresultant CAD for the coordinate family in \(\mathbf p\), and a second signed-subresultant CAD for the target family in \((\mathbf p,\mathbf s)\) together with the lifted coordinate-cell polynomials. This produces the canonical coordinate cells \(\psi_j\) and target cells \(\chi_k\), with their respective unique-value or witness relations, before any fixing trace is enumerated.

After both base partitions have been fixed, enumerate expression-discovery traces. Start from every supported observed margin and partial-context trace kernel written as a rational expression in \(\mathbf p\). Recursively branch only by strict ancestral marginalization, restriction to a proper child of a nontrivial district decomposition, a licensed \(\Phi_v^{\lambda}\) update, or a delayed \(\Sigma_{c'}\) update that strictly extends the partial context. Retain the complete operation word and memoize only literal complete tuples \(\kappa=(\mathcal H,F,c,q,\pi,\Lambda)\), including the syntax of \(q\), \(\pi\), and every provenance entry in \(\Lambda\). An adjacent-swap optimization may merge branches only after replaying both license orders from their common pre-swap state in a fixed canonical order and verifying literal equality of the complete resulting tuples. Fixing and selection are never commuted.

For a candidate coordinate expression \(r(\mathbf p)=N(\mathbf p)/D(\mathbf p)\), a coordinate cell \(\psi_j\), and \((a,y)\) having a unique relation, decide
\[
\forall\mathbf p\,\forall z
\left[
\psi_j(\mathbf p)\wedge\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z)
\Longrightarrow
D(\mathbf p)\neq0\wedge D(\mathbf p)z=N(\mathbf p)
\right].
\]
For a candidate direct-target expression \(r_{\tau}(\mathbf p,\mathbf s)=N_{\tau}(\mathbf p,\mathbf s)/D_{\tau}(\mathbf p,\mathbf s)\), formed as a score-linear combination of compatible trace expressions, and a target cell \(\chi_k\) having a unique relation, decide
\[
\forall\mathbf p\,\forall\mathbf s\,\forall z
\left[
\chi_k(\mathbf p,\mathbf s)\wedge\mathsf V_{\tau}(\mathbf p,\mathbf s,z)
\Longrightarrow
D_{\tau}(\mathbf p,\mathbf s)\neq0
\wedge D_{\tau}(\mathbf p,\mathbf s)z=N_{\tau}(\mathbf p,\mathbf s)
\right].
\]
Annotate a cell only when its implication is true. If no candidate passes, retain the corresponding unique-value graph; on a nonconstant coordinate or target cell retain \(\mathsf W_j\) or \(\mathsf W_{\tau}\), respectively.
